$comment: Schema for a LearningAssistant configuration file. 'default.json' is loaded for all topics. A topic-specific file (e.g. kubernetes-basics.json) can override individual fields.

repetition_weight.description: Fraction of questions in a session drawn from already-seen questions. The complement (1 - repetition_weight) is the novelty weight. 0.0 = always introduce new questions, 1.0 = always revisit old questions.

min_interval_days.description: Minimum number of days that must pass before a question can be repeated. Implements the spaced-repetition floor.

mastery_threshold.description: Mastery score above which a concept is considered 'mastered' and receives lower priority in question selection.

session_length.description: Default number of questions per learning session. Can be overridden at session start.

difficulty_adjustment.description: If true, the scheduler adapts the difficulty range of questions based on recent performance.

difficulty_ramp_rate.description: How quickly difficulty is increased after correct answers (or decreased after incorrect). 0.0 = no ramp, 1.0 = maximum ramp. Only used when difficulty_adjustment is true.

starting_difficulty.description: The difficulty level used when a user first starts a topic and there is no performance history.

low_mastery_boost.description: Extra weight given to questions from concepts with mastery score below mastery_threshold. Higher values focus more heavily on weak areas.
